author: Dana Levi
text: Still the best headphone album ever pressed. Every listen finds something new.

author: Noam Barak
text: Brilliant production, though the middle section drags a little.

author: Yael Cohen
text: Calm, spacious and endlessly cool. The record I put on to think.

author: Omer Shahar
text: Huge songs, but the whole thing sounds very much of its decade.

author: Tamar Peled
text: Pure riff delivery. Loud, short and to the point.

author: Gil Avrahami
text: Well made, but the songs never really grabbed me.

author: Shira Mizrahi
text: It still sounds like someone kicking a door open.

author: Eitan Reznik
text: The quiet-loud dynamics are the whole point and they land every time.

author: Maya Golan
text: Important record, but the singles overshadow the rest of it.

author: Roi Feldman
text: A masterclass in hard bop. The title track alone is worth it.

author: Lior Katz
text: Warm, live-sounding electronic music. Ages very well.

author: Adi Ben-Ami
text: The medley is great, the first half far less so.

author: Nadav Segal
text: The closing side is the best twenty minutes they ever recorded.

author: Hila Rosen
text: Dense and demanding, and it rewards the effort.

author: Ariel Nissim
text: The production is legendary; some of the guest verses are not.
